['Alfred K\u00e4rcher SE & Co. KG '].company_description: Alfred Kärcher SE & Co. KG is a German family-owned company that operates worldwide and is known for its high-pressure cleaners, floor care equipment, parts cleaning systems, wash water treatment, military decontamination equipment and window vacuum cleaners. It is the world market leader in cleaning technology and employs more than 10,000 people worldwide. In 2017, it posted sales revenues of €2.5 billion ($2.88 billion) and sold more than 13 million machines. Kärcher has 100 subsidiaries in 60 countries. In 2020, Kärcher established its North American headquarters in Aurora, Colorado.

['Hewlett Packard GmbH '].company_description: Hewlett Packard GmbH, also known as HP, provides a wide variety of hardware components, software, and related services to consumers, small and medium-sized businesses, and large enterprises, including customers in the government, health, and education sectors. The company offers numerous computers, printers, and other electronic hardware. HP is a global leader in the personal systems and printing industries, with a combined total addressable market in excess of $500 billion.
